Author: Serpens66
Name: Random Events
Description: Runs configurable Vanilla scenario events in singleplayer skirmishes and Trail missions.

Changes: Orders each newly spawned Vanilla bandit tribe to attack a deterministic random living building of the selected human player through Vanilla's native tribe AttackBuilding command.
Disables only further bandit events with a timestamped Error if a game update makes tribe detection or the native attack-order API incompatible.
Adds Vanilla's clickable ActionPoint marker to the selected rabbit infestation source while keeping rabbit spawning independent if marker compatibility fails.
Defers initial event rolls until a human player has a living Lord, preventing an empty startup batch from delaying the first event by one full interval.
Confirms automatic signposts through Vanilla's full CreatePrefab placement rules and now exhausts alternative prefiltered positions when Vanilla rejects a preferred candidate.
Uses the correct Vanilla lion warning voice Random_Events14.wav and removes the obsolete Harmony-based Random_Events8.wav whitelist workaround.

Restores Vanilla's clickable minimap exclamation marker at each lion spawn by resolving and calling the native ActionPoint handler; only the marker is disabled with an Error if a game update breaks its compatibility validation.
Restricts prepared and executed events to active non-AI players with a living Lord while retaining explicit target IDs for future multiplayer synchronization.
Creates automatic signposts for Nature and protects the registered neutral signposts from indirect building-tile damage.
Fixes Vanilla rabbit tribes being blocked by a misidentified shared state value while preserving the native 160-rabbit limit and farm conditions.
Registers Vanilla's omitted Random_Events8.wav Scribe mapping so lion notifications play their existing voice line; only voice playback is disabled if managed compatibility validation fails.
Replaced the Lord-ID-only gate with a resolved Lord unit check that requires IsAlive, the Lord unit type, and ownership by the target player; removed periodic Lord-ID diagnostics.
Lion attacks now use Vanilla's native wildlife handler at the registered signpost closest to the target player's keep or living Lord and arm each created tribe with Vanilla's attack state.
Rabbit infestations now create a proper Vanilla rabbit tribe at one selected point within 12 tiles of an eligible farm, restoring Vanilla spreading and feeding behavior.
Resolves wildlife handlers, prerequisites, tile masks, and lion tribe layout semantically after game updates; only the incompatible rabbit or lion feature is disabled with an Error log.
Restored the 12-tile rabbit search radius and now spawns the complete rabbit group on one randomly selected valid tile so Vanilla movement spreads it naturally.
Skips every random event when the target player's r_LordUnitId is zero or player resources are unavailable.
Logs r_LordUnitId for all eight player slots at Info level every ten seconds while Random Events is active.
Reduced the rabbit infestation radius from 12 to 5 tiles so spawned rabbits form a much tighter group around the selected farm.

Centralized native signature validation around executable PE sections, added a fast validated path for the reference DLL, and isolated handler failures so compatible events remain available after small game updates.
Removed obsolete per-tick heartbeat and full-map prerequisite diagnostics from normal gameplay.

Restored wheat infestation, hops beetles, apple blight, mad cows, and granary theft through their validated native Vanilla effect handlers and original prerequisites without creating Timeline entries.
Queued the original Vanilla video and voice presentation after each successfully applied native event.
Replaced the non-working Vanilla rabbit event with a direct spawn of 10 to 50 neutral rabbits within 12 tiles of a random alive wheat or hops farm owned by the target player.
Removed the native rabbit signatures, gates, source-coordinate manipulation, signpost dependency, and delayed outcome audit.
Removed the non-running Script Extender coroutine dispatcher and all dependent Timeline queues, reusable entries, audits, and save-state fields.
Temporarily disabled the five Timeline-only events with one detailed error per active map while direct Vanilla events remain active.
Added a compact native-analysis handoff for the five Timeline action handlers and upgraded save data to V2.
Moved Timeline mutation to the shared persistent Script Extender dispatcher so all five Timeline-only events can be installed outside the native pre-tick hook.
Resolved and validated Vanilla's rabbit predicate, source array, global gate, count limit, spawner, and rejected-tile mask through semantic signatures.
Rabbit events now select four Vanilla-compatible source tiles near the target player's closest registered signpost and log every native gate decision at Info level.
Fixed a native map-start crash by moving Timeline creation and mutation out of the Script Extender's inline pre-tick hook into a persistent LateUpdate queue.
Added queued, executed, stale, and failed Timeline synchronization diagnostics.
Fixed event scheduling by using Vanilla's twelve-month calendar when the Script Extender reports zero months per year.
Fixed dynamically registered signposts as rabbit sources by supplying their positions through Vanilla's scenario-coordinate path.
Added delayed rabbit-unit outcome diagnostics and rejected saved schedules created with an incompatible calendar basis.
Added monthly and periodic game-time heartbeats to expose stalled or divergent Vanilla calendar readings.
Added before/after prerequisite snapshots for population, farms, granaries, food, rabbits, and registered signposts.
Added Timeline done-flag audits at the due tick and following tick before reusable event records are changed.
Added one emergency signpost search within 50 tiles of the map center when no usable edge signpost exists.
Skipped signpost-dependent events with an error when no registered signpost is available.
Prioritized the registered signpost nearest to the explicit target player's keep and prepared direct events for synchronized target player IDs.
Randomized new edge signposts between 2 and 12 tiles from the map edge and within 100 tiles of the safest candidate.
Preserved saved LobbyModSettings across development builds.
Moved real multiplayer and singleplayer skirmish/Trail detection into the shared GameModeHelper.
Fixed local skirmishes being mistaken for network games, which prevented all random events.
Reduced spacing in the strength controls and added horizontal scrolling for narrow settings views.
Made native signpost resolution tolerant of compatible game DLL updates by validating AOB and structural fallbacks.
If native validation fails, only automatic edge signposts are disabled and a detailed error is logged at Info-visible levels.
Added all 15 Vanilla random events for offline skirmishes and Trail missions.
Added saved deterministic scheduling and safe edge signposts for events that require them.
